scope: Personal training for general-population adults. No diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation prescription or assurance of medical suitability.

backend_model.identifier_strategy: WorkoutPlanExercise.exercise_external_id stores the seeded ExerciseCatalogItem slug, not an invented UUID and not the seed: source_ref. Verify every slug exists in the target catalog before seeding.
backend_model.ownership: Loader injects authenticated owner coach id into WorkoutProgram.coach_id, WorkoutProgram.owner_user_id, and WorkoutPlan.coach_id; links program_id and workout_plan_id using created UUIDs. No client or coach id is embedded in this fixture.
backend_model.metadata_boundary: Only program.data, plan.data and exercise row native fields are Prisma payloads. fixture_key, content, rules, variants, overlays and references are loader metadata, not database columns.
backend_model.assignment: Select a logical master; make a client-specific clone owned by the attached coach using the tenancy-checked clone path. Apply frequency additions, equipment overrides and extra-care overlay BEFORE assignProgramToClient, since that method fans out every non-archived plan and freezes snapshots. Do not mutate the master or filter a snapshot after assignment. Rebuild clone revisions/snapshots via approved service paths after materialization. Completion replay must reuse clone/result and one stable program-assignment idempotency key.
backend_model.schedule: Zero-based week_index and day_index are calendar offsets: start_date + (week_index * 7 + day_index) days. day_index is NOT the nth training day. Offsets are relative to the agreed first session; use one agreed timezone/civil-date anchor consistently.
backend_model.frequency_variant_contract: Default plans always remain. When selected frequency is maximum, append the corresponding additional_plans from frequency_variants and set clone.days_per_week to the selected count. Additional plans are client-clone content, not three more masters. Do not seed/assign every frequency variant together.
backend_model.equipment_override_contract: For the selected program/equipment variant, use equipment_overrides[program_key][variant].by_week[plan.week_index]. Merge the native sparse patch keyed by each original exercise_external_id onto that cloned row. No notes templates or extra row columns are needed. Equipment overrides apply only to the strength plans, not the additional light practice plans.
backend_model.duration_and_effort: No unit, rep-range, per-exercise RPE or prescribed-variant columns exist. REPS/SECONDS, per-side counts, RPE, phase and regressions are explicit in notes (<=500 chars). The integer is a target, not an obligation to finish. UI must show notes and distinguish time from reps; weight_lbs=null means coach/client selects a load, not zero. weight_lbs=0 marks an unloaded regression.

selection.evaluation: First matching rule wins. Produce exactly one program key, selected days, equipment variant, overlay and coach_review_required.

equipment_domain.gym: S3=gym. Equipment substitutions are confirmed by coach if the facility lacks a listed machine.
equipment_domain.home-dumbbells: S3=home or home_some AND S3b contains dumbbells. Stable wall/chair support must be confirmed at first-session setup. No assumption of bench, rack, barbell plates or safe band anchor.
equipment_domain.limited: S3=none, or home/home_some without dumbbells. Kettlebells, bands, barbell, pull-up bar, cardio_machine and other alone are not sufficient for this fixture.
equipment_domain.mixed-unconfirmed: S3=both or mix, regardless of listed home equipment: cannot infer which sessions have gym access. Foundations until coach makes a confirmed-location clone; no new master is needed.

selection.readiness_behavior: Any injury/screening yes or nonempty injury areas triggers extra-care and a private coach-review flag. Assigning Foundations is not medical clearance. Screening does not lock the client out of onboarding; preserve the flag and coach message. Acute symptoms or existing restrictions may make even the unloaded movements unsuitable; skip them and seek appropriate advice.

rules.reason: Extra-care answers take priority over experience, equipment and requested frequency.
Internal selector fallback only; onboarding completion still returns consultation_incomplete for missing/invalid required answers.
Two-day availability is respected at every experience level.
No assumptions about machines, racks, benches, band anchors or which days are at a gym.
Gym access, experience and available days support the four-day upper/lower structure.
Full-body strength fits three days; an optional fourth practice day stays light. Home equipment does not imply a complete gym.
Conservative catch-all; never escalate on unrecognised data.

safety.client_copy: This is personal training, not medical care. Start with the easier option and keep the effort comfortable. You may shorten a session, do one set, or skip an uncomfortable movement. Tell your coach what you changed.
safety.before_each_session: Check how you feel, your available space and support, and any existing restrictions. If a movement is unfamiliar, ask your coach to show the prescribed version. Do not override advice from a qualified health professional.
safety.screening_copy: Thank you for letting us know. We have chosen a supported starting plan and sent your answers to your coach. For now, keep to movements that already feel comfortable, leave extra rest and skip anything that brings on symptoms. Your coach can help adjust your training. Please also speak with your physician about any limits or advice before increasing your activity.
safety.symptoms: Stop exercising for chest pain or pressure, faintness, unexplained dizziness, unusual breathlessness, sudden sharp pain or feeling acutely unwell. Move to a safe resting position. Severe chest pain, severe breathing difficulty or fainting calls for emergency help (911 in the US); do not wait for an app message. Otherwise contact an appropriate health professional and tell your coach before resuming the provoking activity.
safety.joint_response: Choose a range and load that do not provoke joint pain. If discomfort develops, stop that movement; do not use this draft to diagnose the cause. Do not replace it with another painful movement. Message your coach for a suitable option; seek health-professional advice for new, severe or persistent symptoms.
safety.rpe: RPE is your 1-10 effort rating, not a pain score. Here 2-3 means easy, 4-5 comfortable-to-moderate, 6-7 purposeful but controlled. End every set with several comfortable repetitions still possible; no maximum tests, failure sets, breath holding, grinding or forced range.
safety.progression_gate: Targets are ceilings. Advance only when all previous work felt controlled within the RPE cap, ordinary daily activity is not harder afterward, and there are no new/worsening symptoms. Otherwise repeat the previous week, reduce to one set, or ask coach. No catch-up sessions or doubling missed work.
safety.load_progression: Keep the same load while adding the planned rep. If the smallest increment is available and all sets reach the top target comfortably on two exposures, the coach may increase load slightly in the next cycle and return to the Week 1 rep target. Do not simultaneously add sets, load and session frequency. Extra-care clients have no automatic load or volume progression.
safety.warmup: Foundations: about 4-5 minutes of the supported warm-up and easy rehearsal. Strength plans: about 5-8 minutes including easy bike (or home substitution), Wall Slide and a very light 5-rep rehearsal of the first two exercises. Rehearsal sets are not work sets.
safety.cooldown: Allow 2-3 minutes to reduce effort and settle breathing; use the prescribed comfortable cooldown, with rests if useful. Never force a stretch.
safety.shorter_session: Do the warm-up and one set of each comfortable main movement, preserving listed rest and cooldown. Omit the extra practice/conditioning day first. T4 is stored for coach adjustment; it does not silently change the selector.

extra-care.notes_merge: Replace the original RPE sentence with RPE 2-3, then append notes_suffix. Do not leave conflicting original RPE targets in the note.
extra-care.notes_suffix: Extra-care: RPE 2-3, one work set only; no automatic progression. Skip any movement that conflicts with restrictions or brings on symptoms. Ask coach for an individual adjustment.
extra-care.week_behavior: Apply the same caps in all four weeks. Warm-up/cooldown remain gentle and optional if uncomfortable. Never add the third practice day automatically when extra-care is active.

regressions.instructions: Use a fixed support and smaller comfortable depth; remove load. Gym Leg Press is an optional coach-checked alternative only when available and comfortable. If symptoms persist, skip rather than force a depth target.

Use an unloaded small hinge, a supported row and shorter limb reach; wall plank rather than floor if comfortable. No loaded end-range stretch or twisting. If no position is comfortable, omit and ask coach.

Reduce load and reach; fixed-wall Push Up can be easier but is not automatically suitable. Do not force overhead work. Omit overhead press/raise if uncomfortable; coach may use a comfortable existing press, or remove it.
Forearm wall Plank removes hand support if comfortable. Light neutral-grip dumbbells may suit some people, not everyone. Never prescribe a painful grip; omit the affected movement and ask coach.

regressions.area: ankle, foot, balance or floor transfer
regressions.instructions: Keep fixed support within reach, feet planted and range small. Default Foundations has no floor transfers. Use standing supported Cat Cow and wall Plank variants. Omit calf work or any standing movement that is painful or unsteady; seated-only needs an individual coach plan.

regressions.area: screening yes, pregnancy, recent surgery or unknown restrictions
regressions.instructions: No generic diagnosis-based substitution. Preserve restrictions, use extra-care overlay and coach review. Do not prescribe through symptoms or assume Foundations is medically suitable. Existing health-professional advice takes priority.

Their canonical barbell/floor demos must NOT be presented as the prescribed Foundations version. Owner must approve these catalog-linked variations and the client must see their cues before this fixture is seeded for use; otherwise add approved catalog records in separate work and update fixture before launch.

catalog_gaps.gap: No dedicated dumbbell Romanian Deadlift, goblet/front-loaded dumbbell squat or chair-supported row records.
catalog_gaps.handling: Home strength uses notes-level regressions of existing catalog exercises, not new IDs. Confirm support and variant instruction at the first session; do not let a barbell/bench demo override the home cue.

catalog_gaps.gap: No ordinary walking, seated low-impact cardio or seated-only foundations catalog entries; no band/kettlebell strength rows.
catalog_gaps.handling: No invented cardio, seated or band IDs are included. Foundations has movement practice but no aerobic prescription, and Wall Slide is not a loaded pulling exercise. A client unable to use the supported standing versions needs an individual coach adaptation; the draft does not promise universal exercise suitability. Bands/kettlebells alone take the limited-equipment route.

catalog_gaps.gap: Onboarding does not confirm bench, rack, safe band anchors, weights available or which mixed-location days are gym days.
catalog_gaps.handling: Do not infer a complete home gym. Home dumbbells route to Considered Strength with substitutions; mixed locations route to Foundations until coach confirms. Strength & Balance auto-selection is gym-only in v1.
